# kinde_organization_feature_flags (Resource)

Overrides feature flag values for an organization. Only the flags listed in `flags` are managed; overrides set outside Terraform on other flags are left alone. Kinde only accepts organization overrides for flags whose `allow_override_level` is `org`. See [documentation](https://docs.kinde.com/kinde-apis/management/#tag/organizations) for more details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kinde_organization" "acme" {
  name = "Acme"
}

resource "kinde_feature_flag" "beta_access" {
  key                  = "beta_access"
  name                 = "Beta access"
  type                 = "bool"
  allow_override_level = "org"
  default_value        = "false"
}

resource "kinde_organization_feature_flags" "acme" {
  org_code = kinde_organization.acme.code
  flags = {
    (kinde_feature_flag.beta_access.key) = "true"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `flags` (Map of String) Override values keyed by feature flag key. Values are strings in the form Kinde returns them, e.g. `"true"` or `"false"` for boolean flags and `"42"` for integer flags. The flags must already exist.
- `org_code` (String) The code of the organization. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The `org_code`.
